review_candidates.title: Product Manager
review_candidates.description: Maxobiz is a dynamic and innovative software house serving international clients in 30+ countries with different niches. Our dedicated team of professionals collaborates to deliver exceptional web development, design, and marketing services, facilitating and maximizing businesses worldwide. We are seeking a Product Manager with 2-5 years of relevant experience and a strong understanding of product positioning, market research, technology-driven products, and commercial communication to join our team at our Gulberg 3 office in Lahore. Job Responsibilities 1. Product Positioning & Strategy Develop and strengthen the market positioning of products and services by clearly communicating their capabilities, value propositions, and competitive advantages. Define and maintain clear product and service positioning, messaging, value propositions, and key differentiators aligned with business objectives and market expectations. Ensure product and service communication remains aligned with evolving capabilities, business strategy, target markets, and the competitive landscape. 2. Market & Competitor Research Conduct market, competitor, and industry research to identify positioning opportunities, emerging trends, customer expectations, and areas for differentiation. Monitor market presence, customer perception, competitive positioning, and overall relevance to identify opportunities for improvement. 3. Product & Service Presentation Evaluate and improve the presentation of products and services across websites, portfolios, company profiles, social media, directories, and other relevant digital platforms. Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and outdated information across external-facing channels and coordinate necessary improvements. Develop recommendations for improving digital presence, company profiles, portfolios, product presentations, and other customer-facing assets. 4. Technical & Commercial Communication Translate complex technical products, software solutions, and digital services into clear, compelling, and commercially relevant messaging for non-technical audiences. Translate business objectives and technical capabilities into clear, relevant, and market-focused communication. 5. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with marketing, design, content, sales, portfolio, and technical teams to ensure consistent and effective product and service presentation. Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to plan and implement improvements across websites, product pages, portfolios, and other product or brand touchpoints. 6. Performance & Continuous Improvement Track the effectiveness of positioning and presentation initiatives and use market feedback and performance data to recommend improvements. Identify positioning and presentation gaps and develop practical recommendations to improve visibility, credibility, relevance, and consistency. Job Requirements Master’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Product Management, or a related field; MBA in Marketing is preferred. 2-5 years of relevant professional experience in Product Management, Product Marketing, Brand Management, Marketing Strategy, or a closely related role. Practical experience working with technology products, software solutions, digital services, or IT-related businesses. Strong understanding of product positioning, market positioning, brand identity, value propositions, and go-to-market principles. Ability to understand technology and software solutions and communicate their business value without relying entirely on technical teams. Strong market research and analytical skills, including competitor analysis, customer research, industry trends, and target-market assessment. Strong understanding of digital channels, including websites, social media, online directories, portfolios, and other customer-facing platforms. Ability to translate business objectives and technical capabilities into clear, relevant, and market-focused communication. Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong project coordination and stakeholder management skills. Ability to independently identify positioning and presentation gaps and develop practical recommendations for improvement. Strong attention to detail, commercial awareness, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills. Working Conditions Employment Type: Full-time Location: On-site, Gulberg 3, Lahore Working Days: Monday-Friday + Alternate Saturdays Working Hours: 02:00 PM-11:00 PM preferred; 12:00 PM-09:00 PM may also be approved Compensation: PKR 100,000-140,000 per month, based on experience and skills

The ideal candidate has modeling experience and a strong background in capturing hardware, firmware, and human‑machine interaction aspects within SysML-based models. Responsibilities Develop detailed SysML models representing keyboard subsystems, including key matrices, sensors, switches, controllers, interfaces, and ergonomic considerations. Build and maintain MBSE artifacts such as block definition diagrams, internal block diagrams, activity diagrams, state machines, and interface models for keyboard functions. Model keyboard behavior including input processing, debounce logic, communication protocols, power consumption, and user interaction flows. Collaborate with electrical, mechanical, firmware, and human‑factors engineers to incorporate all keyboard‑related requirements and constraints into the system model. Ensure traceability between keyboard requirements, architecture elements, and verification activities within the MBSE environment. Conduct model-based analysis to evaluate performance, reliability, environmental constraints, and system interactions related to keyboard operation. Integrate keyboard subsystem models into larger system architectures and digital engineering pipelines. Apply modeling best practices, enforce model quality standards, and support configuration control of all MBSE artifacts. Provide mentoring and guidance on MBSE modeling techniques and keyboard subsystem representation. Required Qualifications US citizenship and a secret level clearance is required 7+ years of hands‑on MBSE experience with strong SysML modeling skills. Direct experience modeling hardware/software interactions, embedded components, or input peripherals (keyboard, keypads, HMI devices). Bachelor’s degree in systems engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer engineering, or related technical field. Proficiency with MBSE tools such as Cameo Systems Modeler/MagicDraw, Rhapsody, or Enterprise Architect. Solid understanding of systems engineering principles, including requirements, architecture, interface design, and verification. Experience collaborating across multidisciplinary teams (electrical, mechanical, firmware, UX).
